description: Input left over after a complete formula is a syntax error, not silently dropped (T-0105). Hand expectations: Excel for the web refuses a workbook holding B1:B5 (T-0138, docs/excel-semantics/references.md "Trailing input after a complete formula"), so no oracle value exists and #ERROR! is RustSheet's value for a formula it cannot parse. B6 is wrong: Excel loads =(A1)(A2) and gives #REF! (fix and expectation change in T-0149). Kept in its own case so an oracle fill that rejects this workbook does not block the other smoke cases.
